```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)

#Load dataset
input_file <- "C:/Users/cpeng/Downloads/archive/accident_details_compiled.csv"
raw_data <- read_csv(input_file, show_col_types = FALSE)

# Standardise column names (raw file has "Flight #", "AC Type", "cn / ln", etc.)
names(raw_data) <- c("source", "date", "time", "location", "operator", "flight_no",
                     "route", "ac_type", "registration", "cn_ln", "aboard",
                     "fatalities", "ground", "summary")

# case stuff
rx <- function(x) regex(paste(x, collapse = "|"), ignore_case = TRUE)

## Military filtering
military_op <- rx(c("^\\s*mil+i?tary", "/\\s*military", "air ?force", "\\barmy\\b",
                    "\\bnavy\\b", "naval", "marine corps", "\\bUSAF\\b", "\\bRAF\\b",
                    "\\bIAF\\b", "national guard", "luftwaffe", "luftstreitkr",
                    "defen[sc]e", "ministry of", "fuerza\\s+a", "ej[eé]rcito",
                    "armada", "aeronautica militare?", "\\bforce\\b", "soviet air"))
military_sum <- rx(c("military (flight|aircraft|transport|plane)",
                     "air force (plane|aircraft|transport)"))
military_ac  <- rx(c("\\bKC-?\\d", "hercules"))

helicopter_ac <- rx(c("helicopter", "rotor", "rotocraft", "copter", "ecureuil",
                      "\\bMi-?\\d", "\\bMil\\b", "sikors", "\\bAS[- ]?3\\d\\d",
                      "\\bSA ?3\\d\\d", "\\bBell\\b", "robinson", "agusta",
                      "\\bEC[- ]?\\d{3}", "\\bBO[- ]?105", "\\bS-?(58|61|64|70|76|92)\\b",
                      "puma", "chinook", "vertol", "alouette", "frelon",
                      "\\bUH-?\\d", "\\bCH-?\\d", "\\bAW ?\\d{3}", "hughes", "\\bMD ?500"))

## Banning the 2 remaining zepplins
non_airplane_ac <- rx(c("balloon", "blimp", "airship", "glider", "zeppelin"))


## Sorry Wilson
cargo_op  <- rx(c("cargo", "freight", "parcel", "courier", "\\bmail\\b", "\\bFedEx\\b",
                  "\\bUPS\\b", "\\bDHL\\b", "aeropostale", "air ?lift"))
cargo_sum <- rx(c("cargo (plane|flight|aircraft)", "freighter", "all[- ]cargo",
                  "carrying cargo", "mail (plane|flight)"))

## UN Edge case was fun...
govt_op <- rx(c("government", "presidential", "police", "united nations", "\\bUN\\b",
                "red cross", "border (guard|patrol)", "customs", "emergency (ministry|situations)",
                "emercom", "\\bFAA\\b", "\\bNASA\\b", "forest service", "state aviation",
                "royal flight"))

surveillance_kw <- rx(c("surveillance (flight|mission|aircraft|plane)", "reconnaissance",
                        "aerial survey", "survey flight", "aerial photograph", "\\bspy\\b",
                        "intelligence", "news (helicopter|plane|aircraft)"))

## More edge cases
private_op <- rx(c("(^|-\\s*)private", "charter", "taxi", "air ambulance",
                   "flying (club|service)", "illegal flight"))
## Rip Sky King
illegal_sum <- rx(c("illegal", "unauthori[sz]ed", "unlicensed", "unregistered", "smuggl",
                    "drug (smuggl|traffick|flight|run)", "narcotic", "contraband",
                    "clandestine", "stolen|steal"))

## Other edge cases that  can technically be tied to an airliner if it was a training flight or inaugural 
non_revenue_kw <- rx(c("test flight", "training flight", "ferry flight", "positioning flight",
                       "delivery flight", "demonstration flight", "air show", "flight test",
                       "maintenance flight", "demonstration", "\\btest\\b"))

# FILTER
flagged <- raw_data %>%
  mutate(
    across(c(operator, route, ac_type, summary), ~ replace_na(as.character(.x), "")),
    aboard_total = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(str_extract(aboard, "^\\s*\\d+"))),
    passengers   = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(str_match(aboard, "passengers:\\s*(\\d+)")[, 2])),
    crew         = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(str_match(aboard, "crew:\\s*(\\d+)")[, 2])),
    date_parsed  = mdy(date),
    year         = year(date_parsed)
  ) %>%
  # 2002-2023
  filter(!is.na(date_parsed),
         date_parsed >= as.Date("2002-01-01"),
         date_parsed <= as.Date("2023-12-31")) %>%
  # Duplicate removal because there was a goose (plane, not the animal or Goose from top gun(RIP GOOSE))
  distinct(date, operator, registration, location, ac_type, aboard, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  # Matching and filtering
  mutate(excluded_because = case_when(
    str_detect(operator, military_op) | str_detect(summary, military_sum) ~ "Military aviation",
    str_detect(ac_type, helicopter_ac) | str_detect(summary, regex("helicopter", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Helicopter",
    str_detect(ac_type, military_ac)                                       ~ "Military aviation",
    str_detect(ac_type, non_airplane_ac)                                   ~ "Balloon / airship / glider",
    str_detect(operator, cargo_op) | str_detect(summary, cargo_sum)        ~ "Cargo flight",
    passengers == 0 |
      (is.na(passengers) & !is.na(aboard_total) & !is.na(crew) & aboard_total == crew) ~ "No passengers",
    str_detect(operator, govt_op)                                          ~ "Government flight",
    str_detect(paste(operator, route, summary), surveillance_kw)           ~ "Surveillance mission",
    str_detect(operator, private_op) | str_detect(summary, illegal_sum)    ~ "Private / charter / illegal",
    str_detect(route, non_revenue_kw) | str_detect(summary, non_revenue_kw) ~ "Test / ferry / training",
    operator %in% c("", "?", "-")                                          ~ "Unknown operator",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  ))

# TABLES
commercial_pax <- flagged %>% filter(is.na(excluded_because)) %>% select(-excluded_because)
all_excluded   <- flagged %>% filter(!is.na(excluded_because))

# Later chunks use curated_data, so keep it as an alias (already duplicate-free)
curated_data <- commercial_pax

# SUMMARY
cat("Rows in raw file:                         ", nrow(raw_data), "\n")
cat("Rows in date range (after de-duplication):", nrow(flagged), "\n")
cat("Rows after exclusions:                    ", nrow(commercial_pax), "\n\n")
all_excluded %>% count(excluded_because, sort = TRUE) %>% print()

# ---- Check: no duplicates remain ----
dups <- commercial_pax %>%
  count(date, operator, registration, location, ac_type, aboard) %>%
  filter(n > 1)
stopifnot(nrow(dups) == 0)
cat("\nDuplicate check passed: no duplicate rows in commercial_pax\n\n")

# Tally
aircraft_tally <- commercial_pax %>%
  mutate(ac_type = str_squish(ac_type),
         ac_type = if_else(is.na(ac_type) | ac_type == "", "(blank)", ac_type)) %>%
  count(ac_type, sort = TRUE, name = "n_accidents")

print(aircraft_tally, n = Inf)

# Check: tally should add up to the rows after exclusions
cat("Sum of tally:         ", sum(aircraft_tally$n_accidents), "\n")
cat("Rows after exclusions:", nrow(commercial_pax), "\n")

# Spot-check:
# View(all_excluded %>% select(date, operator, ac_type, aboard, excluded_because))
# View(commercial_pax %>% select(date, operator, ac_type, aboard, route))
```



```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(jsonlite)
library(stringi)

# helper 
norm_name <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    stri_trans_general("Latin-ASCII") %>%      # Aérea -> Aerea, Türkiye -> Turkiye
    str_to_lower() %>%
    str_replace_all("&", " and ") %>%
    str_replace_all("[^a-z0-9 ]", " ") %>%
    str_squish()
}

# Generic words dropped
generic_words <- "\\b(airlines?|airways?|air ?lines?|aviation|aviacion|aereas?|inc|ltd|ltda|llc|corp|company|co|sa|sas|pty|limited|the|international|services?|enterprise|express)\\b"
strip_generic <- function(x) str_squish(str_replace_all(x, generic_words, " "))

# language cleaner
clean_operator <- function(x) x %>% str_remove_all("\\(.*?\\)") %>% str_remove("/.*$") %>% str_squish()

# path to filke can change
json_file <- "C:/Users/cpeng/Desktop/airlines_by_country.json"

if (!file.exists(json_file)) {
  stop("Can't find the JSON file at: ", json_file,
       "\nR is looking from this folder: ", getwd(),
       "\nPut the file there or use the full path.")
}

rm(list = intersect("raw_lookup", ls()))          # clear any stale object with this name
raw_lookup <- fromJSON(json_file) %>% as_tibble() # <- this is the line that was missing
stopifnot(is.data.frame(raw_lookup), all(c("Country", "Airline", "Airline_URL") %in% names(raw_lookup)))

# The URL ends in the real airline name 
url_name <- function(u) {
  slug <- str_match(u, "/airline/([^/?#]+)")[, 2]
  slug <- vapply(replace_na(slug, ""), utils::URLdecode, character(1), USE.NAMES = FALSE)
  str_replace_all(slug, "-", " ")
}

airline_names <- bind_rows(
  # names as listed in the scrape (excluding the photo counts like "94")
  raw_lookup %>%
    filter(!str_detect(Airline, "^[0-9,]+$")) %>%
    transmute(Country, name = Airline),
  # names recovered from the URL slug
  raw_lookup %>%
    transmute(Country, name = url_name(Airline_URL))
) %>%
  filter(!is.na(name), name != "") %>%
  distinct(Country, name) %>%
  mutate(key = norm_name(name), key_generic = strip_generic(key))

# One row per name
lookup_exact <- airline_names %>%
  filter(nchar(key) > 1) %>%
  group_by(key) %>%
  summarise(countries = list(sort(unique(Country))), .groups = "drop")

lookup_generic <- airline_names %>%
  filter(nchar(key_generic) > 1) %>%
  group_by(key = key_generic) %>%
  summarise(countries = list(sort(unique(Country))), .groups = "drop")

lookup_candidates <- function(keys, lookup) lookup$countries[match(keys, lookup$key)]

# If a name appears under several countries, only accept 1
pick_country <- function(candidates, reg_c) {
  map2_chr(candidates, reg_c, function(cs, r) {
    if (is.null(cs)) NA_character_
    else if (length(cs) == 1) cs
    else if (!is.na(r) && r %in% cs) r
    else NA_character_
  })
}

# ---------- 2. ICAO nationality marks ----------
reg_prefix_country <- c(

  "A2"="Botswana","A3"="Tonga","A40"="Oman","A5"="Bhutan","A6"="United Arab Emirates","A7"="Qatar","A9C"="Bahrain","AP"="Pakistan",

  "F"="France","FO"="French Polynesia","G"="United Kingdom",
  "H4"="Solomon Islands","HA"="Hungary","HB"="Switzerland","HC"="Ecuador","HH"="Haiti","HI"="Dominican Republic","HK"="Colombia","HL"="Korea, Republic Of","HP"="Panama","HR"="Honduras","HS"="Thailand","HZ"="Saudi Arabia",
  "I"="Italy","J2"="Djibouti","J3"="Grenada","J5"="Guinea-Bissau","J6"="Saint Lucia","J7"="Dominica","J8"="Saint Vincent And The Grenadines","JA"="Japan","JY"="Jordan",

  "T2"="Tuvalu","T3"="Kiribati","T7"="San Marino","T8"="Palau","TC"="Türkiye","TF"="Iceland","TG"="Guatemala","TI"="Costa Rica","TJ"="Cameroon",

  "5A"="Libya","5B"="Cyprus","5H"="Tanzania, United Republic Of","5N"="Nigeria","5R"="Madagascar","5T"="Mauritania","5U"="Niger","5V"="Togo","5W"="Samoa","5X"="Uganda","5Y"="Kenya",
  "6O"="Somalia","6V"="Senegal","6Y"="Jamaica","7O"="Yemen","7P"="Lesotho","7Q"="Malawi","7T"="Algeria","8P"="Barbados","8Q"="Maldives","8R"="Guyana",
  "9A"="Croatia","9G"="Ghana","9H"="Malta","9J"="Zambia","9K"="Kuwait","9L"="Sierra Leone","9M"="Malaysia","9N"="Nepal",
  "9Q"="Congo, The Democratic Republic Of The","9S"="Congo, The Democratic Republic Of The","9U"="Burundi","9V"="Singapore","9XR"="Rwanda","9Y"="Trinidad And Tobago"
)

reg_to_country <- function(reg) {
  r <- str_remove_all(str_to_upper(replace_na(as.character(reg), "")), "[^A-Z0-9]")   # "C-GPCD" -> "CGPCD"
  by_prefix <- coalesce(unname(reg_prefix_country[substr(r, 1, 4)]),   # longest prefix wins
                        unname(reg_prefix_country[substr(r, 1, 3)]),
                        unname(reg_prefix_country[substr(r, 1, 2)]),
                        unname(reg_prefix_country[substr(r, 1, 1)]))
  case_when(r == ""                    ~ NA_character_,
            str_detect(r, "^B\\d{5}$") ~ "Taiwan",          # Taiwan uses 5-digit B-xxxxx
            str_detect(r, "^N\\d")     ~ "United States",
            TRUE                       ~ by_prefix)
}

# Edge cases
manual_overrides <- tribble(
  ~pattern,    ~country,
  "^comair$",  "United States",       # lookup wrongly gives Comair (South Africa)
  "metrojet",  "Russian Federation"   # Kogalymavia / Metrojet
)
manual_country <- function(op) {
  out <- rep(NA_character_, length(op))
  for (i in rev(seq_len(nrow(manual_overrides)))) {
    hit <- str_detect(op, regex(manual_overrides$pattern[i], ignore_case = TRUE))
    out[hit] <- manual_overrides$country[i]
  }
  out
}

# JOin Crash and country
crashes_country <- curated_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(operator), operator != "") %>%
  mutate(
    key_full    = norm_name(operator),
    key_clean   = norm_name(clean_operator(operator)),
    key_generic = strip_generic(key_clean),
    reg_country = reg_to_country(registration),

    c_manual = manual_country(operator),
    c_exact  = pick_country(lookup_candidates(key_full,    lookup_exact),   reg_country),
    c_clean  = pick_country(lookup_candidates(key_clean,   lookup_exact),   reg_country),
    c_fuzzy  = pick_country(lookup_candidates(key_generic, lookup_generic), reg_country),
    c_fuzzy  = if_else(c_fuzzy == reg_country, c_fuzzy, NA_character_),   # fuzzy only trusted if registry agrees

    Country = coalesce(c_manual, c_exact, c_clean, c_fuzzy, reg_country),
    country_source = case_when(
      !is.na(c_manual)      ~ "manual override",
      !is.na(c_exact)       ~ "airline list: exact name",
      !is.na(c_clean)       ~ "airline list: cleaned name",
      !is.na(c_fuzzy)       ~ "airline list: fuzzy name (confirmed by registration)",
      !is.na(reg_country)   ~ "registration prefix",
      TRUE                  ~ "unmatched"),
    country_differs_from_registry = !is.na(reg_country) & Country != reg_country
  )

# Check
cat("Matched:", sum(!is.na(crashes_country$Country)), "of", nrow(crashes_country), "\n\n")
crashes_country %>% count(country_source, sort = TRUE) %>% print()

# Anything still unmatched...
crashes_country %>% filter(is.na(Country)) %>% count(operator, registration, sort = TRUE) %>% print()

# Edge Case
crashes_country %>%
  filter(country_differs_from_registry) %>%
  select(operator, registration, Country, reg_country, country_source) %>%
  print(n = Inf)

# ---------- Crashes by country chart ----------
country_counts <- crashes_country %>%
  filter(!is.na(Country)) %>%
  count(Country, sort = TRUE)

country_counts

country_counts %>%
  slice_max(n, n = 15, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(Country, n), y = n)) +
  geom_col(fill = "darkslateblue") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Top 15 Countries by Accident Count",
       subtitle = "Commercial Passenger Fixed-Wing Aircraft (2002–2023)",
       x = "Country", y = "Number of Accidents") +
  theme_minimal()

  filter(!is.na(ac_type), ac_type != "") %>%
  mutate(ac_type = str_to_title(trimws(ac_type))) %>%
  count(ac_type, sort = TRUE) %>%
  slice_max(n, n = 15, with_ties = FALSE) %>%

```{r}

library(pscl)      
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)


airline_year_panel <- curated_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(operator), operator != "") %>%
  mutate(operator = str_to_title(trimws(operator))) %>%
  # Count actual accidents per airline per year
  count(operator, year, name = "n_accidents") %>%
  # Expand grid to include all combinations of operators and years (2002-2023)
  complete(
    operator, 
    year = 2002:2023, 
    fill = list(n_accidents = 0)
  )

# Preview the panel showing zeros
head(airline_year_panel, 10)

# Formula structure: count_variables ~ predictors | zero_inflation_predictors
zip_model <- zeroinfl(
  n_accidents ~ year | year, 
  data = airline_year_panel,
  dist = "poisson" # Use "negbin" if your data exhibits high overdispersion
)

# View model summary
summary(zip_model)


standard_poisson <- glm(n_accidents ~ year, data = airline_year_panel, family = poisson)

vuong(zip_model, standard_poisson)
```

```{r}
airline_year_panel <- airline_year_panel %>%
  mutate(predicted_accidents = predict(zip_model, type = "response"))

ggplot(airline_year_panel, aes(x = year, y = n_accidents)) +
  geom_jitter(alpha = 0.3, width = 0.2, height = 0.1, color = "darkslateblue") +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "line", color = "firebrick", linewidth = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Observed vs. Model-Predicted Accident Trends (2002–2023)",
    subtitle = "Zero-Inflated Poisson Regression Fit",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Number of Accidents per Airline"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
